reason: Verification failed on key specification requirements: several required metrics and validation checks are missing, spec parameter names are not honored, and policy feedback loops are absent. With two iterations remaining, there is clear, high-impact work that can bring the simulation into spec compliance in the next pass.

specific_areas: Implement missing metrics: time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption_rate, adoption_disparity_index (and Gini), policy_effect_size (simple DiD or average mandate_rate), average_enforcement_events_per_day, masks_purchased_per_capita, campaign_reach (ever-exposed), post_policy_dropoff_rate.
Add validation checks and report them: adoption_convergence (last 7-day deltas < 0.01), stock_nonnegativity, bounded_probabilities (track any p outside [0,1]).

Align parameter mappings with the spec: penalty_for_noncompliance -> penalty_amount; mandate_enforcement_level -> location_enforcement_mean/enforcement_strength; campaign_intensity -> messaging_intensity; retailer_initial_stock_per_100_agents -> retailer_initial_inventory_per_capita=value/100; campaign_start_day gating; media_bias_variance for tone noise.
Implement policy feedback loop: adjust mandate status and/or campaign intensity based on recent 7-day adoption/compliance and prevalence trends; cap parameters within [0,1].
Track cumulative campaign reach (ever-exposed IDs) and enforcement events per day (penalties + denials).
Compute adoption disparity by income terciles and report both range (max-min) and Gini across group rates.
Measure post-policy drop-off by comparing last 7 days before mandate end to first 7 days after.
Extend Person fields or document mappings for spec completeness (gender, socioeconomic_status, workplace_id, political_identity, perceived_norm).
Optionally integrate or remove unused SupplyChain to reduce confusion; ensure CSV logging includes new metrics and validations.

task_understanding.adjustments: Re-center on strict adherence to the provided spec: required KPIs, validations, parameter names/mapping, and policy feedback interactions must be implemented and surfaced in outputs.

data_analysis.adjustments: Define clear computation windows: 7-day moving averages for convergence and policy feedback; pre/post windows around mandate end for drop-off; group-level aggregation for disparity.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan minimal but complete additions to meet spec with low risk: state tracking for ever-exposed, enforcement events, group indices; simple DiD or average-based policy_effect_size; bounded probability clamps.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement parameter remapping, new metrics computation in run(), small state tracking in step(), and policy feedback logic. Keep changes localized and well-commented to avoid regressions.

code_verification.adjustments: Add internal assertions/logs for bounded probabilities; quick sanity checks for nonnegative stocks; unit-like checks for metric computations (e.g., time_to_50 search, group rate calculations).

simulation_execution.adjustments: Gate campaign by campaign_start_day and campaign_intensity; ensure enforcement level and penalties are applied per mapped parameters; maintain reproducibility with seed.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Assemble and return the full metrics and validations block; compute and include disparity and drop-off; verify that series and metrics align with spec names and units.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Report pass/fail of validations with brief explanations; highlight policy_effect_size method used; note any assumptions or mappings made for spec compatibility.
